title: Historical path content adjudication
scope: Seven specifically authorized historical paths only; all other paths remain subject to the original publication checks.
phase: read-only adjudication; no commit, push, index edit, ignore edit, history rewrite, fetch, or remote change

files.evidence: Three-line notice about private label storage and public/private separation. It enumerates no per-compound label, outcome, structure–result pair, activity value, or credential.

Script classifies files and counts label-bearing files by path group; output schema contains grouped paths, booleans, and counts only. It does not write individual sample data or a matched credential value. Hard-coded absolute path contains username only.

Script moves private files while checking hashes and writes old/new relative paths, SHA-256, and time to an ignored mapping file. No embedded sample rows, activity values, or credential values; hard-coded absolute path contains username only.

Historical versions write secrets_scan.md rows with file path, line number, and matched pattern names, plus SSH-field presence; no matched string or partially masked value. Also writes a .gitignore draft. Literal regular expressions and generic placeholders are code, not credential values. Hard-coded absolute path contains username only.

Actual CSV header is path_group,private_named_path,reverse_scan_nonprivate,files_scanned,compound_level_label_files,archive_label_data_files,git_ignored_label_files,git_unignored_label_files,scan_errors. All 30 rows contain only path-group names, booleans, or counts; no cmp_-prefixed key and no molecular outcome, label, structure–result pair, or activity value. First 3 and last 3 rows are summarized in Markdown.

Eleven-line grouped audit summary reports numbers of directories/files and ignored private mappings. It contains no compound/activity identifier paired with an outcome, no numeric activity, and no credential value.

Historical Markdown reports use file/line/pattern tables (three cells), SSH-field presence, totals, and explanatory text. Keyword and credential-style hits are locations and pattern categories only; no matched value, masked prefix, per-molecule label, structure–result pair, or activity value.
